original_test_intent: Update the exact approved E1.S drive with EPK98B5Q.BIN using its supported firmware slot/action, activate through the required power sequence and prove the intended firmware is active while data, identity and health remain intact.
original_method: Map drive serial/model/namespace/controller/BDF/slot and exclude boot/data devices; back up data and capture NVMe health, firmware slots and current revision; verify signed image checksum/model compatibility/release notes and vendor activation semantics; download to the verified controller; confirm staged slot; activate the approved slot/action; perform controlled power cycle, wait/re-enumerate/verify; honor the source ten-second wait and second approved cycle; validate active revision, namespace/data integrity, PCIe/SMART/errors and rollback readiness.
manual_activity: Storage owner authorizes the exact drive/image/activation and maintenance window; lab operator controls stable power cycles and recovery.
safety_requirements: Never select by mutable /dev name alone
Use OOB and controlled power actions
Stop on identity/compatibility/health mismatch; no auto-retry or log clearing
agent_execution_scope: Execute exact approved download and activation phases

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unsafe as written because it substitutes target, image, slot and action.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve placeholders to a serial-verified controller and use only the vendor-approved semantic equivalent of source `fw-download ... EPK98B5Q.BIN` plus `fw-activate -a 1 -s 2`; preview identity before each write.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source image, action 1, slot 2, first cycle, revision recheck, about-ten-second wait and second cycle retained pending approval.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a phase ledger for identity, image hash, staged slot, activation, each power event and verified post-flash data/health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable identity, signed compatibility, backup, stage inspection, post-health and vendor recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A revision-only check cannot prove correct drive selection, data integrity or safe activation across both cycles.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong target or incompatible firmware can cause permanent data/device loss; ambiguous nvme-cli action numbers vary by context/version and must be vendor-confirmed.

project_override_considerations: Owner resolves placeholder device, whether slot 2 is writable/supported, action-1 behavior, why two cycles are required, exact timing anchor and accepted active revision string.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek changes the Master target, filename and activation slot/action; those substitutions cannot be treated as equivalent without an approved vendor mapping.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review complete; destructive execution gated by exact target, image, activation semantics, backup, power and recovery approval.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row432 Wistron-Storage-00067-V002: approve exact E1.S serial/model/controller/namespace/BDF/slot replacing /dev/nvmexn1, EPK98B5Q.BIN provenance/version/checksum/compatibility, slot2/action1 semantics, backup/non-boot proof, dual-power-cycle and 10-second timing, expected active revision and vendor rollback/recovery.

review_improvement: Prevents mutable device-name and activation-parameter substitutions from turning a firmware review into an uncontrolled storage write.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware download and activation are distinct states: successful transfer does not prove the intended slot became active. Identity and firmware-slot logs must span both power cycles, and data/health must be verified because a matching revision alone can coexist with wrong-target or degraded media.
